text: E haawnu on nde tawi wahyu on e waaju ngun ardii on immorde ka Joomi mon e ɗemngal gorko jeyaaɗo e mo'on?! Hara le ko hakkunde mon o mawni, o anndiraaka fenaande e majjere. O arii on himo jertina on e lepte Alla ɗen si on fennii on yeddii, o nodda on e hulugol Alla ɗoftoo Mo woɗɗitoo haɗaaɗi Makko, belajo'o, O Yurmee on si on gomɗinii Mo.
